config.enhancedlittlemaidai.title: ELMAI
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.compr: Memory count threshold to trigger LLM compression
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.dedup: BM25 similarity above which memories are considered duplicates (0.5~1.0)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.compr: Number of oldest memories to compress in each batch
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.memory.targe: Maximum number of summaries generated by LLM after compression
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.co: Min interval between proactive chats, 600 = 10 min
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.tr: Probability of triggering proactive chat per tick after cooldown
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.ma: Maximum proactive chat triggers per game session
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.mi: Owner must be within this distance for proactive chat to trigger
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.proactive.ev: Min interval between environment event-triggered chats, 300 = 5 min
Maximum environment event chat triggers per game session
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.context.bfsD: Maximum BFS scan depth for nearby blocks (higher = larger area)
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.context.enti: Maximum range (blocks) for detecting nearby entities
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.context.maxE: Maximum number of entity details returned to the LLM
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.mining.enabl: Replace MLM hardcoded mining messages with LLM dialogue based on maid character setting
config.enhancedlittlemaidai.debug.debugL: Enable detailed debug output to log file
